step1_analysis.description: Two NMOS transistors that can function as a differential amplifier or the RF transconductance stage of a downconversion mixer when their sources are tied to a common tail current.

paper_reference.title: A Direct-Conversion Receiver for the 3G WCDMA Standard

Voltage Gain.description: Differential low-frequency voltage gain of the amplifier stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vov. With Id=0.5mA per branch, W/L=10, Vov~0.6V, gm~1.66mS. With a 2kOhm load resistor, Gain = gm*R = 3.32 V/V = 10.4 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen load resistor and tail current in the testbench.

Unity Gain Bandwidth.description: Frequency at which the differential voltage gain drops to 0 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW ~ gm / (2 * pi * Cload). With gm=1.66mS and Cload=100fF, UGBW ~ 2.6 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is limited by the RC time constant and parasitic capacitances at the output nodes.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the stage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Set by the 1mA tail current source added in the testbench.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure differential voltage gain, unity gain bandwidth, and power consumption of the NMOS pair.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Pair Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_2 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Power Supply and Biasing
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
I_tail N_tail 0 1m
V_tie1 N4 N_tail 0
V_tie2 N6 N_tail 0

* Loads
R1 VDD N2 2k
R2 VDD N1 2k
C1 N2 0 100f
C2 N1 0 100f

* Inputs (DC bias + AC + Transient Sine)
V_INP LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5 sin(0.9 0.1 100Meg)
V_INN LABEL_NET_2 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5 sin(0.9 -0.1 100Meg)

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point
op
let power = 1.8 * (-i(VVDD))
print power

* 2. AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1Meg 10Gig
let out_diff = v(N1) - v(N2)
let gain_mag = mag(out_diff)
let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis
tran 100p 20n
meas tran vout_max max v(N1)
meas tran vout_min min v(N1)

quit
.endc
.end
